result.summary: 本文提出了“精度感知”的缩放定律，将训练精度和推理精度纳入语言模型的损失预测中 [abstract]。作者提出低精度训练会降低模型的有效参数量，并据此预测低精度训练和后训练量化带来的额外损失 [abstract]。研究发现，后训练量化带来的退化随训练数据量增加而增大，最终使额外的预训练数据变得有害 [abstract]。作者在超过 465 次预训练运行上拟合，并在最高 17 亿参数、260 亿 token 的模型上验证了预测 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：精度、参数量和数据量之间存在怎样的权衡，这些权衡在预训练和推理时有何不同 [S1.p1]。原文指出，精度是影响成本和性能的第三个重要因素，而当前的缩放定律并未考虑这一点 [S1.p1][abstract]。

evidence.quote: What are the tradeoffs between precision, parameters, and data? How do they compare for pretraining and inference?
However, the precision in which models are trained and served is an important third factor that contributes to both cost and performance.
Low precision training and inference affect both the quality and cost of language models, but current scaling laws do not account for this.

method.text: 论文提出“精度感知”的缩放定律，核心思想是低精度训练会降低模型的有效参数量 N_eff，从而将精度与参数量统一起来 [S1.p2]。作者将 Chinchilla 缩放形式中的 N 替换为 N_eff，并进一步将权重、激活和 KV 缓存的量化效应建模为独立且乘性的噪声 [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS2.p5]。对于后训练量化，作者将退化建模为随 token/参数比 D/N 增长的幂律项，并引入“鲁棒化”效应来统一训练和推理精度的影响 [S3.SS1.p1][S5.p4]。

evidence.quote: This functional form that posits bit precision and parameter count interchangeably contribute to a model’s “effective parameter count,” $N_{\text{eff}}$
We therefore modify Chinchilla scaling to account for $N_{\text{eff}}$ by making the substitution $N\mapsto N_{\text{eff}}(N,P_{\text{w}})$
The effects of quantizing the weights, activations, and KV cache during training are well modeled as independent and multiplicative
We find that the degradation $\delta_{\text{PTQ}}$ increases in training data size across all model sizes

This motivates modifying our initial functional form fitted in Section 3 to $\delta_{\text{PTQ}}(N,D,P_{\text{w}},P_{\text{post}})=C_{T}e^{-P_{\text{post}}/\gamma_{\text{post}}}\underbrace{\left(\frac{D^{\gamma_{D}}}{N_{\text{eff}}^{\gamma_{N}}}\right)}_{\text{Overtraining effect}}\underbrace{[1-e^{-C_{\text{w}}(P_{\text{w}}-P_{\text{post}})}]}_{\text{Robustification effect}}$

experiments.text: 作者在 Dolma V1.7 数据集上训练和评估了一系列 OLMo 风格的模型，模型规模 N 为 3000 万至 2.2 亿非嵌入参数，数据量 D 为 15 亿至 260 亿 token [S2.SS3.p1]。实验扫描了权重、激活和 KV 缓存的训练精度（3 至 12 位），并对每个模型进行多种精度的后训练量化 [S4.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。作者在超过 465 次预训练运行上拟合缩放定律，并在最高 17 亿参数、260 亿 token 的模型上验证预测 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: We train and evaluate a suite of OLMo-style models on the Dolma V1.7 dataset
Our experiments consist of a sweep of language model pretraining runs over $N\in[30,60,110,220]$ million parameters (non-embedding) and $D\in[1.5,3,6,13,26]$ billion tokens.
We sweep the training precisions of the weights, activations, and KV cache $P_{\text{w}},P_{\text{a}},P_{\text{kv}}\in[3,12]$ individually
We fit on over 465 pretraining runs and validate our predictions on model sizes up to 1.7B parameters trained on up to 26B tokens.

findings.text: 后训练量化的损失退化随训练数据量增加而增大，对于固定模型，当 D/N 足够大或量化精度足够低时，额外的预训练数据反而会增加量化后的损失 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS1.p3]。训练时量化权重、激活和 KV 缓存的效果可建模为独立且乘性的，共同影响有效参数量 [S4.SS2.p5]。当联合优化 N、D、P 时，计算最优的预训练精度与计算预算无关，拟合结果约为 7-8 位；但当模型大小 N 固定时，计算最优精度随计算预算对数增长 [S4.SS3.SSS2.p1][S4.SS3.SSS3.p1]。统一缩放定律在超过 1000 个数据点上取得 R²=0.90 的拟合 [S5.p6]。

evidence.quote: We find that the degradation $\delta_{\text{PTQ}}$ increases in training data size across all model sizes
This implies that when $D/N$ is sufficiently large, or $P_{\text{post}}$ sufficiently small, loss after quantization can increase as models are pretrained for longer
The effects of quantizing the weights, activations, and KV cache during training are well modeled as independent and multiplicative
which reveals that in general the optimal pretraining precision is independent of compute budget.
We find this $P^{*}$ to be around 7-8 bits when fitting our scaling law on runs with quantization done to integer type.
our scaling laws predict that models of differing sizes should not necessarily be trained in the same precision, and that compute-optimal precision scales as $P^{*}(C)\propto\log C$.
We measure the fit to the data of such a functional form in Figure 7, and find a strong fit with $R^{2}=0.90$ on over 1000 data points

limitations.text: 作者承认，研究使用固定架构来考察精度、参数和 token 的影响，而低精度训练常涉及架构调整，可能缩小与全精度模型的差距 [S6.p2]。计算成本虽随精度线性缩放，但由于系统开销，减半精度带来的收益通常不到 2 倍 [S6.p2]。研究仅考虑损失缩放，未进行下游模型评估 [S6.p2]。作者强调所发现的趋势旨在提供启示而非规定性结论，并希望未来工作能在更大模型规模上更全面地检验这些效应 [S6.p2]。

evidence.quote: First, we use a fixed architecture throughout to examine the effects of precision, parameters, and tokens in a controlled manner.
In contrast, low precision training often involves architectural tweaks that can close much of the gap from a vanilla full precision model.
Second, while compute costs do scale linearly with precision, the gains from halving precision are usually less than 2x due to systems overhead.
Third, we only consider loss scaling without downstream model evaluations.
We emphasize that the trends we find aim to be suggestive rather than prescriptive, and hope future work can more comprehensively examine these effects at larger model scale.
